# iDroid protocol golden vectors (frame format 1)
#
# Every line is "<name> <lowercase hex frame>". A frame is:
#   magic "IDR0" | protocol version u8 | message kind u8 | payload length u32 LE | payload
#
# These bytes are the cross-language contract. Rust, Kotlin, and Swift must
# decode them identically and must produce identical bytes when encoding the
# same message. Protocol version 1 carries the legacy lifecycle/data frames;
# version 2 carries the control-plane frames whose identity is a 32-byte
# public-key fingerprint.
#
# Do not edit a vector to make an implementation pass. Add a new vector with a
# new name and record why the old one is retired.

hello.mac.v2 4944523002113500000001000200ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff020500312e322e33010807060504030201
hello_ack.v2 494452300212020000000200
bye.normal.v2 49445230021a03000000000000
bye.timeout.v2 49445230021a0400000001080100
data.v1 4944523001060b0000002a00000000000000010203
heartbeat.v1 4944523001021000000002000000000000000300000000000000
